# Serverless Designer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills

## Overview

Use when designing serverless architectures with event triggers, function composition, and cold start optimization.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [serverless-designer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
serverless-designer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@serverless-designer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze technical systems and identify areas for improvement
- Execute automated workflows with validation checkpoints
- Apply technology-specific best practices and industry standards
- Generate structured technical outputs with quality metrics

## Industry Standards Applied

- **Well-Architected Framework**: Cloud architecture pillars: security, reliability, performance, cost, operations
- **12-Factor App**: Methodology for building cloud-native, scalable services
- **CIS Benchmarks**: Security configuration baselines for cloud platforms
